title: CTSP Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) CALGB 50303
summary:
What makes this cohort worth knowing about is not its size but its provenance. The samples come from CALGB 50303, a randomized phase III trial comparing dose-adjusted EPOCH-R against R-CHOP as frontline therapy for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Molecular data collected inside a randomized trial are scarce: treatment assignment is not confounded with patient characteristics, which is the assumption that almost every observational treatment-response analysis has to make and cannot verify.
Vital status is informative for 100% of the 45 cases and median follow-up is 60.4 months. RNA sequencing covers 44 cases, exome 44 and a targeted panel all 45.
one_liner: 45 diffuse large B-cell lymphomas from the randomized CALGB 50303 trial - small, but every case has complete vital status, five years of median follow-up, and a known randomized treatment assignment.

useful_for.question: Do molecular subtypes of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma predict differential benefit from dose-adjusted EPOCH-R versus R-CHOP?
useful_for.rationale: This is a predictive-biomarker question, and it requires randomized treatment assignment to answer properly. RNA sequencing on 44 cases supports cell-of-origin and subtype classification, and the trial provides the randomization.
useful_for.statistical_note: 45 cases split across two arms cannot power a treatment-by-subtype interaction test. This is a design demonstration and a hypothesis-generating analysis, not a definitive one. Trial arm assignment must be obtained from the trial group; it is not in the GDC clinical records.

useful_for.question: How well do molecular classifiers built on observational DLBCL cohorts perform on uniformly treated trial patients?
useful_for.rationale: Classifier performance usually degrades when treatment heterogeneity is removed, because some apparent prognostic signal is really treatment-selection signal. A uniformly treated, randomized cohort is the right place to detect that.
useful_for.statistical_note: Validation only; too small for training.
